student.name: Study Permit
eligibilityCriteria: Have an acceptance letter from a Designated Learning Institution (DLI)
Prove sufficient funds for tuition, living costs, and return transportation
Have no criminal record; a police certificate may be required
Be in good health; a medical exam may be required
Satisfy an officer that you will leave Canada when your permit expires
A Provincial or Territorial Attestation Letter (PAL/TAL) is required for most applicants under the study-permit cap; certain doctoral and master's research programs are exempt as of January 2026
requiredDocuments: Letter of acceptance from a DLI
student.fees: CAD $150 study permit fee + CAD $85 biometrics fee, where required
student.processingTime: Varies by country of application; check IRCC's processing-times tool for the current estimate
student.validityDuration: Length of the study program plus 90 days

tourist_visitor.name: Visitor Visa (Temporary Resident Visa)
eligibilityCriteria: Hold a valid travel document (passport)
Be in good health; a medical exam may be required
Have no criminal or immigration-related convictions
Demonstrate ties to your home country (job, home, financial assets, family)
Convince an immigration officer you will leave Canada at the end of your visit
Have enough money to support your stay
requiredDocuments: Proof of financial support (bank statements, pay stubs)
Letter of invitation from a Canadian host, if applicable
Biometrics (fingerprints and photo) at a Visa Application Centre
tourist_visitor.fees: CAD $100 visa fee + CAD $85 biometrics fee (approx. CAD $185 total per adult); capped at CAD $500 for a family of 5 or more applying together
tourist_visitor.processingTime: Varies by country of application. IRCC publishes current estimates by country on its processing-times tool; recent published figures include roughly 22 days for applicants from the United States and 27 days for applicants from India (as of April 2026).
tourist_visitor.validityDuration: Up to 10 years or until passport expiry, whichever comes first; usually multiple-entry

tourist_visitor.name: Standard Visitor Visa
eligibilityCriteria: Hold a valid passport or travel document for the whole stay
Show you will leave the UK at the end of your visit
Show you can support yourself and any dependants during the trip
Show you can pay for your return or onward journey
Show you will not live in the UK for extended periods through frequent or successive visits
requiredDocuments: Evidence of funds to support the visit
Evidence of ties to home country / return travel plans
Biometric information (fingerprints and photo) at a UKVCAS appointment
tourist_visitor.fees: £135 for up to 6 months; long-term options available (2, 5, or 10 years) for frequent visitors
tourist_visitor.processingTime: Standard service aims for a decision within 3 weeks; priority and super-priority services are available for an extra fee
tourist_visitor.validityDuration: Up to 6 months per visit; long-term visas allow repeat visits within a 2/5/10-year window

student.name: Student Visa
eligibilityCriteria: Be 16 or over
Have an unconditional offer and Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) from a licensed student sponsor
Show you have enough money to support yourself and pay for your course
Meet the required knowledge of English
Have parental consent if you are 16 or 17
requiredDocuments: Proof of funds (tuition and living costs, held for 28 consecutive days)
TB test certificate, if applicable to your country
ATAS certificate, for certain postgraduate courses
student.fees: £558 to apply from outside the UK (same fee to extend or switch from inside the UK), plus the Immigration Health Surcharge
student.processingTime: 3 weeks if applying from outside the UK; 8 weeks if applying from inside the UK
student.validityDuration: Up to 5 years for degree-level courses if you're 18 or over; up to 2 years for below-degree-level courses
